name: Shimojō (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shimojō village emblem in white: a stylised angular device of a letter V with a disc, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Shimojō, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 19 October 1989.

features.role: Shimojō village emblem — a stylised angular device of a letter V with a disc, like a bird
